changelog: Sales lead page reads the hand-off chain (`previousRelationId`, `src/lib/leadJourney.ts`): the earlier owners' interactions appear in a collapsed per-period section, the header says who the lead was taken over from, and a handed-on record shows a banner naming the current owner with a link when the viewer may open it (#3817).

en: After a hand-off, the lead page shows the earlier owner's interactions in a collapsible section, and the old record points to the current owner.
tr: Devirden sonra lead sayfası önceki sorumlunun etkileşimlerini katlanır bir bölümde gösteriyor; eski kayıt da güncel sorumluyu gösteriyor.
de: Nach einer Übergabe zeigt die Lead-Seite die Interaktionen des früheren Zuständigen in einem aufklappbaren Bereich, und der alte Datensatz verweist auf den aktuellen Zuständigen.
